senses.gloss: ; ch. form אַרְדִּיכְלָא (אדר׳) m. (prob. from a place or country, cmp. אַרְגּוּבְלָא) artist, artisan (v. P. Sm. 370 s. v., a. derivat.) esp. architect, key-stone-setter.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 118b:2">B. Mets. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>בנאי … לא׳</he> (ed. <he>אדרי׳</he>) when the builder has handed the key-stone over to the architect (to set it). Y. ib. X, end, 12ᶜ <he>ארדכל</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:3">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <cite ref="A03173"><he>אר׳</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:3">ib.</cite> s. 27 <cite ref="D00792"><he>אד׳</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>ארְדִּיכְלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 5:11">Targ. II Sam. V, 11</cite> (h. text <he>חרשי אבן קיר</he>); a. e.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 26a">Erub. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אַרְדַּ׳</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>דאַרְדַּכְלֵי</he>; ed. <he>אדר׳</he>).—<he>אַרְדִּיכְלַיָּא</he> <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 118:22">Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 22</cite>; a. e.
